docling.probe_source:
import inspect
from docling.backend.pypdfium2_backend import PyPdfiumDocumentBackend
from docling.datamodel.document import InputDocument
from docling.datamodel.base_models import InputFormat
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys
path = Path(sys.argv[1])
doc = InputDocument(path_or_stream=path, format=InputFormat.PDF, backend=PyPdfiumDocumentBackend)
backend = doc._backend
page = backend.load_page(0)
print(json.dumps({"backend": "Docling PyPdfiumDocumentBackend", "valid": backend.is_valid(), "page_count": backend.page_count(), "page_size": page.get_size().model_dump(), "image_size_72dpi": page.get_page_image(scale=1).size}))
backend.unload()
